storage_layout.file_naming_rule: job_uid must be a path-safe identifier and is the only path-derived variable in v1

append_only_policy.allocation_records: append-only JSON Lines; never rewrite earlier allocation entries in place
append_only_policy.cost_event_records: append-only JSON Lines; never rewrite earlier cost entries in place

replay_rules.remaining_budget_formula: sum(allocation.amount_minor_units) - sum(cost.amount_minor_units where direction=debit) + sum(cost.amount_minor_units where direction=credit)
replay_rules.unit_policy: all allocation and cost records for one job_uid must carry exactly one shared unit string

field_definitions.allocation_uid: Path-safe stable identifier for this allocation entry.
field_definitions.job_uid: Path-safe stable identifier for the owning job.
field_definitions.recorded_at_utc: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.
field_definitions.amount_minor_units: Positive integer amount in the declared unit.
field_definitions.unit: Lowercase canonical unit slug such as usd_cents or token_milliunits.
field_definitions.allocation_reason_code: One of the canonical allocation reason codes.

field_definitions.cost_event_uid: Path-safe stable identifier for this cost event entry.
field_definitions.job_uid: Path-safe stable identifier for the owning job.
field_definitions.recorded_at_utc: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.
field_definitions.amount_minor_units: Positive integer amount in the declared unit.
field_definitions.unit: Lowercase canonical unit slug matching the job's allocation unit.
field_definitions.direction: debit decreases remaining budget; credit increases remaining budget.
field_definitions.cost_reason_code: One of the canonical cost reason codes.

rejection_rules: Reject any record missing its entry UID, job UID, recorded_at_utc, amount_minor_units, unit, or reason code.
Reject any record that stores remaining_budget_minor_units or any other mutable balance scalar; remaining budget is replay-derived only.
Reject replay for a job if allocation and cost records disagree on unit or if duplicate entry UIDs appear within the same record family.
